whatThisIs: Check a CMS Hospital Price Transparency v3.0.0 machine-readable file in your browser. The checker streams CSV tall, CSV wide and JSON files, so memory use follows the current row or charge item instead of the whole file.
whenToUse: Use this before publishing or analyzing a hospital price file. It catches missing 2026 fields, bad template values and broken conditional relationships while keeping the file on your device.
inputs: One CMS v3.0.0 CSV or JSON hospital price file. The practical size limit is what your browser can open; the standard 50 MB upload-workbench limit does not apply.
output: A pass result or a capped table of structural deficiencies with each CSV row or JSON path, plus the total deficiency and charge-row counts.
